# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the change in a few sentences.

## Testing

- [ ] `PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/pytest -q`
- [ ] `./scripts/acceptance-open-source-client.sh` if discovery/control behavior changed
- [ ] Manual test notes, if relevant:

## Checklist

- [ ] Small, focused change.
- [ ] Tests added or updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] README/docs updated when commands, config, or behavior changed.
- [ ] No proprietary code, app/firmware fragments, assets, screenshots, logos, or copied material.
- [ ] No raw dumps, raw packet captures, real MAC addresses, real UUIDs, serials, private IPs, tokens, cookies, keys, certificates, or credentials.
- [ ] No authentication, DRM, signature, pairing, certificate, encryption, or access-control bypass.
- [ ] Logs remain sanitized by default.

## Risk Notes

Mention any compatibility, privacy, or legal-risk concerns reviewers should check.
